messages:
maria.d: Heads up — PR 54211 updates the quantization profile for llm-small to int8. Unit tests green but saw ~3% latency regression in a preliminary canary run.
kevin: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/pr/54211 — thanks for flagging. Is this happening on the new kernel selection path?
sasha: can you paste the perf numbers and whether it's median or p95?
maria.d: quick numbers: median +1.2%, p95 +3.1%. throughput (tokens/s) about the same. runtime v2.3.0 + kernel branch opt-int8.
nick: @sasha @kevin tagging runtime + platform — we need eyes before merge. Could be kernel selection or KV layout change.
sasha: I can look at kernel diffs, but need CI/logs. maria, any failing tests?
maria.d: CI mostly fine, one flaky in quant-inference-test. Log snippet: ```RuntimeError: kv cache mismatch at step 42 — got size 2048 expected 2064```
kevin: that log smells like a layout/stride change during serialization. Also want to confirm no protocol or wire changes that would affect Private customers.
maria.d: no protocol changes; only storage ordering and a tiny write path tweak. KMS/HSMs untouched.
sasha: ok I'll repro locally against the kernel branch. @orch-bot can you re-run a canary with model=llm-small, config=quant-int8, sessions=50?
orch-bot: Canary scheduled: run-id 2026-03-18-01, started. ETA ~15m. Will post results here. :robot_face:
maria.d: timeline: need runtime + platform sign-offs by EOD so we can merge in tomorrow morning slot. Who can own the merge if canary looks good?
nick: I can take the merge if runtime (+1) and platform (+1) are present. Runtime owner: sasha. Platform owner: kevin. Security: no changes, but @security-team pls shout if you disagree.
sasha: aiming for +1 after local repro and quick perf check — targeting 11:30am.
kevin: I'll review the rollout config and rollback hook; will post any blockers by noon.
maria.d: thanks all. I'll monitor the canary run and paste results. If canary passes and both give +1, I'll request the merge window for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
orch-bot: Canary run complete. Summary: no crashes, median latency +1.1%, p95 +2.9%, quant-inference-test flake reproduced in 2/50 sessions. Detailed log: https://ci.redwood.ai/canary/2026-03-18-01
maria.d: reproduced flake noted — filed follow-up issue #893 with reproducer. Will we merge with a follow-up fix, or block until kv layout is fixed?
sasha: if the flake is deterministic from the layout change we should fix before wide rollout. I'll dig in now and update thread.
kevin: agree with runtime. Platform notes: add a canary rollback window and keep the previous model variant pinned for 24h.
nick: sounds good. thanks for quick responses — keep updates here and ping me when you have a final decision. :thumbsup:
